source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 10 June 1933, p. 5 ("Fermanagh boards: Enniskillen Rural Council", first meeting of the newly elected council)
source.check: Read on the page image (INA block image): at the first meeting of the newly elected Enniskillen Rural District Council (Tuesday 6 June 1933) 'Mr. Thos. Elliott, J.P.' proposed the Earl of Belmore as chairman; the three members co-opted that day are named (T. Smith, H. Montgomery-Irwin, James Beattie), so Elliott sat as an elected member.

note: Triennial rural district council election, polled Wednesday 31 May 1933 where contested; Drummee was the only contest in this district (Fermanagh Herald, 6 May 1933, p. 5, and the results, 10 June 1933, p. 5). Monea is the one division missing from the nominations lists printed for this election (Impartial Reporter, 4 May 1933, p. 5; Fermanagh Herald, 6 May 1933, p. 5), and Drummee was the only rural contest. Thomas Elliott, J.P., won Monea in 1930 and is not named for any of the other twenty-five divisions, so he is placed in Monea by elimination (inferred). If no nomination was made there, he was deemed re-elected as the retiring member.
